@@U02204@@
Serenade When across the soft-green meadows Warm and gentle breezes play, Closing round in misty shadows Softly falls the close of day; Whispers gently peace to mortals, Rocks the heart to childlike rest, Closes up the daylight’s portals To those wearied eyes unblessed. Notturno Now the night is deeply darkling, Hallowed star joins hallowed star, Lights of power, or faintly sparkling, Glimmer near, and gleam afar; Glimmer in the lake so tender, Gleam in heaven’s vault profound; The bright moon reigns in full-orbed splendor, Making perfect peace abound. Mattutino The hours of the night have vanished, Joy and grief are passed away. Feel the promise! Pain is banished! Trust the new and hopeful day. Vales grow green, hills steep and steeper, Shadows deepen thick with leaves, And the harvest to the reaper In long silvery billows heaves. Réveille Wishes, win them, without number, Turn and face the dawning day, You are wrapped in sleep’s light slumber, Cast it off and greet the day! Be bold where others fear to tread, Seize the day for all its worth,

小夜曲 当穿过软绿的草地 温暖而柔和的微风吹过， 笼罩在薄雾的阴影中 轻轻地落下一天的结束；温柔地向凡人低语和平， 摇动心灵，让孩子般的休息， 关闭日光的门户， 关闭那些疲惫的眼睛，不加祝福。现在夜已深沉，神圣的星星加入神圣的星星，力量之光，或微弱地闪烁，近处微光，远处闪烁；湖光温柔，天穹深邃；明月圆明，太平遍地。马图蒂诺 夜晚的时光已经消失，欢乐和悲伤都过去了。感受承诺！疼痛被消除了！相信充满希望的新一天。山谷绿意盎然，山峦愈加陡峭， 阴影因树叶而加深， 收割者的收获在长长的银色波涛中起伏。雷维尔的愿望，赢得它们，无数，转身面对黎明，你沉浸在睡眠的浅睡中，摆脱它，迎接新的一天！大胆去别人不敢涉足的地方，抓住这一天的全部价值，
